subject: Endorsement of Anna Callahan for State Representative
overview: Former Richmond, California Mayor Gayle McLaughlin formally endorsed Anna Callahan for Massachusetts State Representative. The endorsement emphasized Callahan's background in progressive community organizing and her commitment to running a corporate-free campaign.

items.title: Endorsement and background
items.summary: Gayle McLaughlin endorsed Anna Callahan for State Representative, citing Callahan's history with the Richmond Progressive Alliance and her work training candidates through an organization called the Incorruptibles.

items.title: Candidate platform and policy priorities
items.summary: McLaughlin outlined Callahan’s policy positions, including support for Medicare for All, housing for all, a Massachusetts Green New Deal, a living wage, and free public college.

items.title: Campaign mobilization and fundraising
items.summary: McLaughlin encouraged public participation and donations for the campaign, noting that Callahan does not accept corporate or super PAC money.
